label: Non-residential Recipient Not In
applies_when: A business recipient is not in and driver release is not permitted because of signature requirements, driver judgment, or no OP-201 on file.

label: Inspection Required
applies_when: A package has possible damage and is being returned to the station for inspection.
scope_notes: A leaking or hazardous package requires a separate safety procedure.

label: Package Sorted to Wrong Route
applies_when: A package is found on the van after dispatch but should have been loaded to a different van.
scope_notes: The code definition does not independently establish the complete package-disposition workflow.

label: Package Refused by Recipient
applies_when: A recipient refuses a call tag, or an ASR or alcohol recipient refuses to provide ID for age verification.
scope_notes: A refused call tag also requires signatures on the physical tag and FORGE delivery record, code and time on the tag, and station check-in.
Valid ID presented but unscannable after an attempted scan uses the limited manual-verification contingency instead.

label: Residential Recipient Not In
applies_when: A residential recipient is not in and driver release or an approved alternate delivery path is unavailable, including a call-tag stop where the recipient is not home and did not leave the package.
locator: pages 34, 46, and 53, residential recipient not in

label: Call Tag Not Ready
applies_when: The call-tag package is not ready and the driver cannot return later that day.
scope_notes: Requires customer signatures on the call tag and FORGE delivery record, plus code and time on the back of the tag.

label: Call Tag Picked Up
applies_when: A call-tag package is successfully picked up.
scope_notes: The call-tag label becomes the new shipping label and the top tab is the recipient tracking receipt.
locator: page 53, Picking up a Call Tag

label: Call Tag Restricted
applies_when: A call-tag package cannot be picked up because of shipping restrictions, inadequate packaging, or damage.
scope_notes: Hazardous material under a call tag is separately prohibited and requires original-shipper instructions.
